what: eval/realism.py on every T013 seed (calibration and held-out): per check, statuses across seeds and the mean and spread of each numeric value

checks.target: 1.5-2.5 global; 5-9 per region
notes: global on requests; per region on visit starts (requests per region are dominated by a few heavy users), regions with 20+ visits in every hour

checks.target: browser 1.05-1.15; developers 1.35-1.45; CI about 2.5 (2.0-3.0)
notes: people on visit starts in their own local days (UTC days smear each zone's weekend and lower the ratio by about 5%, reported alongside); CI on UTC requests (cron schedules run in UTC)

checks.check: session starts are Poisson within an hour
checks.target: dispersion of per-minute session starts about 1 (0.8-1.25); requests over-dispersed
notes: visits: a session ID's requests with gaps under 30 min (people)

on_multiseed_mean.rule: session-start dispersion 0.8-1.25 and request dispersion above 1.5

checks.target: H 0.7-0.85 (variance-time, 1 s to 10 min, busy hours)
notes: per busy hour, 1-second bins aggregated up to 6 minutes; median over hours

checks.target: think-time tail alpha about 1.5 (1.3-1.7)
notes: gaps between a person's consecutive requests after a page or API answer (not a file transfer), from 30 s (Crovella's think times) to 10 min (beyond that, mostly between visits); truncated-Pareto MLE

checks.target: a mixture: cron and loops near 0, people and agents above 1, few near 1
notes: CV of burst-start gaps (bursts split by 30 s of silence), entities with 10+ bursts

checks.target: rank exponent 0.8-1.0 (head); 1.5-1.8 for ranks 1k-10k
notes: snapshot calls per repository, ranks 3-300; the tail check can't run with about 800 repositories (gap 9)

checks.target: about 2% of downloads go to repositories under 30 days old (1-4%)
notes: repositories created inside the logged window are all under 30 days old

checks.target: half of peak in 1-20 min; decay p 0.6-1.4; 40-80% of prefixes seen before
notes: each repository created in the window with 300+ requests; half-peak on 10-min smoothed counts; decay p on 10-min counts from twice the time to peak (30 min at least) to 24 h; pass when most releases pass

checks.target: bursts of about 40 requests in under 2 s, at most 8 concurrent; mostly HEAD; 302 present; 404s mostly on first loads
notes: size follows the catalogue's file counts (3-11 files, so 7-25 requests; a 26-file repository gives 42, tests/test_sim_client_emulator.py); concurrency estimated as requests starting within 20 ms

checks.target: retry gaps 1, 2, 4, 8, 8 s; after a 429, resume at reset + 1 s
notes: the hub serves no 5xx, so the 1-2-4-8-8 s back-off is checked by tests/test_sim_client_emulator.py (known answer t0+1, +3, +7, +15, +23)

checks.target: harness mix as in 2.6; fan-out bursts of 10-20 calls about every 10 s
notes: the harness mix can't be checked: hub.client.UA_FAMILIES has no agent/<harness> tag

checks.target: benign pairwise correlations have a heavy upper tail from look-alikes 1-8
notes: Pearson correlation of hourly request counts, accounts with 20+ requests in 6+ distinct hours (sparse accounts correlate by coincidence); pass when at least 10 benign pairs reach 0.8 and most of them involve look-alike behaviours 1-8 (the normal population's CI bots count with CI)

checks.target: AUROC near 0.5
notes: needs real reference traces (Wikimedia, WorldCup, NASA, PyPI): a download that needs the user's OK (gap 12)

checks.target: one arm with a real human timing trace
notes: needs a real trace (gap 12)

checks.target: false alarms rise with look-alikes present
notes: needs the monitor's alarm (T006) and one run per ablation

checks.target: every cell with a median of 1% or more inside the 3.3 median +-50%; mobile 15-35% of human pages; Tor at most 0.3%; relay at most 1% of pages; hosting at least 50% of resolvers
notes: the suspected_resi_proxy cells are left to O13: 3.3's medians (1.3/3.7/5.1%) need several times more real proxy traffic than O13's 'about 4 in 5 labelled requests are direct' allows, so the two can't both hold; the cells are reported

supplementary.computed_by: scripts/t013.py (eval/realism.py hard-codes O8 and V16 as 'not run'; these are T013's provisional versions, for the realism owner to adopt or replace)

O8.check: long-run per-user entropy (human page logins, 22 days)
O8.target: IP about 2 bits, ASN about 0.8 bits (0.76 in the anchor)
O8.provisional_tolerance: the multi-seed mean within 50% of each anchor
O8.definition:
Long-run per-user origin entropy of human page sessions (eval/realism.py's O8;
    research/origin-model.md V8: "IP about 2 bits, ASN about 0.8 bits" over 3-4 weeks).

    A *login* is a person's first page request (a browser user agent) on a simulated day;
    people are the realism scorecard's PEOPLE archetypes. For each person with at least 12
    login-days, the Shannon entropy in bits of the logged /24 (`origin_net`, the hub's IP
    field) and of the ASN over those logins. Truth only labels who is a person, as in
    eval/realism.py; the statistic reads logged fields only.

V16.target: the false-alarm rate rises when look-alikes are present
V16.note: the minimal version: one ablation with every look-alike off, on the held-out seeds, at the frozen thresholds (not one run per population); false alarms are entries into Sev-1, -2 or -3 on evaluation days
